name: Hitori Tabi de Itta Saki de Masaka Ano Kirai na Joushi to Souguu ~Kou Natta no mo Zenbu, Dotacan Shita Kareshi no Sei Dakara ne~
original_name: 一人旅で行った先でまさかあの嫌いな上司と遭遇 ～こうなったのも全部、ドタキャンした彼氏のせいだからね～
source:
It was the morning of the hot spring trip she’d planned with her boyfriend.
She received a message from her boyfriend saying he couldn’t make it.
Hikaru had been feeling lately that his heart was drifting away from her.
This trip was supposed to be a chance to mend their crumbling relationship, yet…

Her expectations were dashed, leaving a gaping hole in her heart.
But Hikaru decided to put it behind her and, hoping to find some healing on her own,
resolved to head to the inn by herself.

—But fate had other plans.

What was supposed to be a peaceful solo trip took a sudden turn.
There, waiting for her, was the person she found hardest to face at work:
her boss, Atsushi Kuroiwa—the person she disliked the most at the company.
She never in her wildest dreams imagined she’d run into him in a place like this.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01004545.html/]dlsite[/url]]
